data: This course introduces students to modes of history writing in India with a specific focus on modern and contemporary periods. We will begin with a brief survey of how the past was remembered and documented in ancient and mediaeval India. Then our goal will be to study different schools of modern historiography such as Colonial, Nationalist, Cambridge, Marxist, Subaltern and Hindutva. Students will learn to recognize the underlying conceptions of past and history present in different schools and also the narrative strategies deployed.
